key_insight: An LLM agent uses physics simulations to inverse-design fabrication recipes for target depth profiles of implanted ions or vacancies.
engineering_relevance: The approach could help engineers translate desired spatial material structures into ion-processing recipes with minimal human input.
method: Specify a target ion or vacancy depth profile.
Have the agent select ion species, energies, incident angles, and target material layers.
Run and interpret ion–matter simulations, iteratively refining the recipe to match the target.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulated matching of target depth profiles but provides no quantitative accuracy metrics, benchmark comparisons, or experimental validation.
watch_item: Practical fabrication accuracy remains dependent on simulator fidelity and experimental verification.
paper_title: Agentic inverse design of spatially programmed materials
